description: Start here. Finds Star Wars entities by name (title for FILMS) with a case-insensitive substring match: 'sky' finds Luke, Anakin and Shmi Skywalker. Returns a JSON array of full entities; an empty array [] means no match. The id to pass to sw_get is the last segment of each entity's url field. Data covers Episodes I-VI only.

resource.description: Resource type: PEOPLE, FILMS, PLANETS, SPECIES, STARSHIPS or VEHICLES. Any other value returns a tool error.

name: sw_search
